ms.promise:
A restore script for Cardano node database snapshots that allows the user to start a cardano node with a snapshot produced by the mithril network.
Source code (excluding any proprietary deployment related code) and documentation.
ms.criteria:
The restore script successfully restores the downloaded snapshot (allowing Cardano node to continue syncing from that point). To do that, it fetches the latest snapshot from the Mithril network and runs cardano-node using that.
The the restore script, is publicly accessible with an open source licence.
ms.report:
Please find our PoA report, detailing our deliverables, here:
https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardanow/issues/31

ms.promise:
Implementation of a Kupo snapshot service (a program that runs alongside Kupo and saves database snapshots).
Testing and deployment of the Kupo snapshot service.
A restore script for Kupo database snapshots (and optionally a systemd unit file that runs the restore script prior to starting Kupo).
Source code (excluding any proprietary deployment related code) and documentation.
ms.criteria:
Kupo database snapshots are automatically taken at least once per epoch for each public network (mainnet, preprod, and preview).
The latest two snapshots for each network are retained, at minimum.
Anyone can access key metadata about the database snapshots programmatically in JSON format (containing download URL and any other relevant information).
Files downloaded from each URL are valid Kupo database snapshots.
The restore script successfully restores the downloaded snapshot (allowing Kupo to continue syncing from that point).
